objects.name: What vulnerability prioritization looks like when KEV, EPSS, and CVSS disagree
objects.description: In this Help Net Security interview, Dr. Active exploitation comes first, then exploit likelihood, then technical severity, with adjustments for asset exposure, business criticality, and compensating controls.
